title: Synthetic dataset catalog
summary: Synthetic source document with stable section anchors.

details.clean: DATA-001: 2,400 synthetic clean trays across four recipe variants. Generated labels, no customer imagery.
details.defects: DATA-002: 600 synthetic defects, including folds and contamination. Intended for pipeline development only; cannot establish real-world accuracy.
details.shift: DATA-003: 300 synthetic lighting and pose shifts. Camera-corner coverage is missing; new acquisition research is required.
